# wso2is_application (Data Source)

Looks up an application by ID, name or OAuth2 client ID, for example the built-in Console or My Account application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_application" "console" {
  name = "Console"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `name` (String) Application name.

### Read-Only

- `access_url` (String) Access URL.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in.
- `is_management_app` (Boolean) Whether it can call the management APIs.
- `issuer` (String) SAML issuer.
- `protocols` (Set of String) Configured inbound protocols: `oauth2`, `samlsso`, `passivests`, `wstrust`.
- `template_id` (String) Console template.
